<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Nested & parsed'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing XML-like markup <child> and &internal; -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and -- hyphens --
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % prm "<!ELEMENT prm_elem (#PCDATA)>">
  %prm;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:ext="http://example.org/ext">
  <!-- Header comment for document structure -->
  <section id="s1">
    <?target-pi data="processing instruction value with <tags>"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed character data block with <markup> and &reference; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&ent2;</section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "Catalog Item Reference">
  <!ENTITY % param_ent "<!ENTITY param_use 'Parameter expansion test'>">
  %param_ent;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-base href="http://example.org/base/"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before complex elements -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="item1.xml">
    <?xml-pipeline debug="on" trace="full"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with various symbols: <>&'"--
    ]]>
    &param_use;
  </item>
  <item>&ref;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY e_combo "&e_base; combined with more text">
  <!NOTATION bmp SYSTEM "image/bmp">
  <!ENTITY pic SYSTEM "image.bmp" NDATA bmp>
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ATTLIST record status CDATA 'active'>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.com/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archival root element comment -->
  <record meta:id="rec-001">
    <?meta-info type="summary" status="verified"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested-fake-doctype>
      <tag>Some raw content inside CDATA</tag>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&e_combo;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (data*)>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent_a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent_b "&ent_a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY % def_macro "<!ELEMENT macro_elem (#PCDATA)>">
  %def_macro;
  <!NOTATION html SYSTEM "text/html">
  <!ENTITY index SYSTEM "index.html" NDATA html>
]>
<?xml-script type="application/javascript" src="parser.js"?>
<container xmlns="http://example.net/container" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment describing the container usage and namespaces -->
  <data id="d1">
    <?xml-data-source type="sql" query="SELECT * FROM data"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing unescaped <xml> tags, & entities, and -- comments --.
    ]]>
  </data>
  <data>&ent_b;</data>
</container>
```
